title: Are Countries Getting Worse on Emissions as They Urbanize?
description: DSC 106 Project 2: a website that explores a climate-change dataset and presents visualizations arguing both for and against the proposition that countries get worse on emissions as they urbanize.

title: NBA Win Prediction
description: DSC 148 final project: built win-prediction models from historical NBA player box scores, filtering out garbage-time minutes, comparing logistic regression baselines against XGBoost, and using SHAP analysis, ablation studies, and case studies to identify which stats actually drive wins.

title: CA Trout Fishing Optimizer
description: Built an end-to-end ETL pipeline in Python that scrapes California CDFW trout stocking data, ingests weather and barometric pressure from REST APIs, loading processed data into PostgreSQL on a daily schedule using AWS Lambda with processed data archived to S3. Developed a weighted scoring model which factors stocking recency, water temperature, pressure trends, and cloud coverage to rank optimal fishing locations by day, visualized through an interactive dashboard with maps, rankings, and historical trend visualizations.

title: Dive into League of Legends
description: DSC 80 project with Sreekar Vemula: analyzed 2022 professional League of Legends match data from Oracle's Elixir to ask whether a player's stats at 10 minutes predict a win. Covered data cleaning, EDA, missingness analysis, and hypothesis testing; a tuned Random Forest reached 60.99% test accuracy versus a 58.82% logistic regression baseline.
